about_title: Five times faster than TIG, with almost no heat in the part
about_text: A fiber laser welder joins stainless, aluminum, galvanized and mild steel sheet with a narrow, deep seam at five times the speed of TIG, with almost no distortion and no grinding afterwards; an operator learns the handheld gun in a day. The portable S series runs 0.8 to 1.5 kW air-cooled from a 220 V outlet; the HWM welds to 9/32″ with 1.5 to 3 kW, a wire feeder and a 4-in-1 head; the RW cells put 1.5 to 20 kW on a 6-axis robot with positioners and tracks; the CMW cobot and the teaching-free RMW bring MIG robots to shops that have never programmed one. The laser cladding machines rebuild shafts, rolls, cylinders and bores with a metallurgically bonded wear layer — in a robot cell, on a lathe bed, or on site.

Senfeng Laser has built fiber laser machines in Jinan, Shandong, since 2004: a 1.8 million ft² campus, its own laser sources, cutting heads and welding guns, around 15,000 machines a year, 20 overseas branches and Senfeng Laser USA with a warehouse and service team. CE, FDA and ETL certified. NovoTech sells, installs and supports the machines in Canada from Mississauga, ON, Canada — layout for your building, installation, operator training, a CSA-approved panel, a 1-year warranty and parts and technical support in Canada.
